draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for the kind words on onboarding — glad it felt smooth, and I see Tariq already covered your seats question (seats can be added any time from Account Settings).

You've got your first project set up, which is the main thing: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Wrenfield tends to click once a second person is in there with you — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want a quick 15-minute call this week to map out your first few projects together?

Best,
Priya
